metadata.description: Skills for coding agents that use Everpod.

plugins.name: everpod-developer-pod
plugins.description: Gets the user a developer pod on Everpod, an always-on, persistent cloud computer of their own with Claude Code and Codex installed, reached only over their own Tailscale network. Use when the user wants a cloud machine or remote server where their coding agents keep working with the laptop closed, wants to run Claude Code or Codex in the cloud, or mentions Everpod or a developer pod.
